tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Commodity-Backed Warehouse Token
underlyingAsset: Canada state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility
description: Business Development Bank of Canada issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Workforce Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Canada public sector service contract — vetted suppliers, maintenance contractors and consultants engaged by Business Development Bank of Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in Canada — managed by Business Development Bank of Canada with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: Business Development Bank of Canada issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by Business Development Bank of Canada in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 CAD unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Daily economic activity of casual workers, contract staff and micro-vendors contracted by Business Development Bank of Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Capital Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Construction and development project milestones verified by independent engineers at Business Development Bank of Canada projects in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Agricultural Offtake Token
underlyingAsset: Smallholder and commercial farm produce procured by Business Development Bank of Canada under government off-take programmes in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada SME Supply Chain Participation Token
underlyingAsset: Small and medium enterprise contracts awarded by Business Development Bank of Canada under preferential procurement policies in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada SOE Diversified Portfolio ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Diversified exposure to all tokenised assets across Business Development Bank of Canada enterprise operations in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada launches a basket ETF token spanning all 15 tokenised asset classes within its operations. A single token gives retail investors diversified exposure to infrastructure, commodities, labor, SME supply chains and government bonds from 1 CAD unit.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Partial State Equity Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional economic interest in Business Development Bank of Canada — Canada government retains majority ownership
description: Business Development Bank of Canada issues fractional equity tokens representing an economic interest in enterprise profits. The government retains majority control while citizens, pension funds and diaspora investors access ownership stakes from 1 CAD unit, distributing national resource wealth broadly.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada SOE Development Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Sovereign-backed development bond issued by Business Development Bank of Canada to finance capital expansion in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 CAD unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Universal Access Financial Inclusion Token
underlyingAsset: Financial inclusion initiative of Business Development Bank of Canada targeting unbanked and underserved communities in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada deploys a universal access token to extend its core services to unbanked rural and peri-urban communities. Women's cooperatives, youth groups and disability enterprises receive preferential allocation at issuance, with minimal KYC via mobile digital identity.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Critical Mineral Royalty Token
underlyingAsset: Canada critical mineral royalties and production-sharing revenue from Business Development Bank of Canada operations
description: Business Development Bank of Canada tokenises the mineral royalty stream from government-owned resource operations. Every citizen holding a royalty token receives a direct share of natural resource revenue, converting extractive industry profits into universal basic wealth distribution.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada Farmer Verification Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Satellite and IoT verified agricultural output records for farmers supplying Business Development Bank of Canada in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada mints an agriculture proof-of-work token for each independently verified farming event — planting, cultivation and harvest — recorded by satellite and IoT sensors. Verified records build a formal credit identity for smallholder farmers with no prior banking history.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework

tokenName: Business Development Bank of Canada End-to-End Supply Chain Track Token
underlyingAsset: Multi-step supply chain provenance trail from production through to delivery — managed by Business Development Bank of Canada in Canada
description: Business Development Bank of Canada tokenises every custody transfer and logistics event across its supply chain on an immutable ledger. Each step earns employment tokens for transport operators and warehouse workers, creating a traceable, tamper-proof record from source to end consumer.
regulatoryFramework: Financial Administration Act; OSC Crypto Asset Framework
